name: chat-callouts
description: Labels and frames chat messages in the terminal and draws drafts and commands in their own copyable boxes

replyStyle.title: Reply style
replyStyle.description: How Claude's replies are marked: label (name and time only), box (rounded frame) or bar (colored bar down the left).

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Thickness of the bar, 1 to 8 eighths of a cell. 8 is a full cell and gap-free in every terminal.

barOnMyMessages.title: Frame on my messages
barOnMyMessages.description: Draw the bar or box around your own messages too. Off leaves just the You label.

draftBoxes.title: Draft boxes
draftBoxes.description: Ask Claude to fence drafts (Slack, email, PR, ticket) and commands for you to run, and draw each in a copyable box. Adds about 120 prompt tokens. Off draws them as plain text.
